record.one_liner: Global network and developer platform (CDN, DNS, security, Workers, storage) managed through a public REST API.
record.auth_notes: API tokens (user or account-owned) and legacy Global API Key; Cloudflare also documents OAuth 2.0 applications for third parties. critic: added oauth2.
record.access_notes: Free plan exists (start building for free, no credit card) and API tokens are created in the dashboard with no paid gate seen; OAuth availability table lists Free. No approval step found for OAuth clients.
record.api_notes: Reference REST API plus separate GraphQL Analytics API; ~2,500 endpoints per official MCP README. REST is the primary style.

evidence.quote: Create an API token to grant access to the API to perform actions.
OAuth allows third-party applications to securely access Cloudflare resources without requiring users to share long-lived API tokens.
To create an API token, from the Cloudflare dashboard, go to My Profile → API Tokens and select Create Token.
